PlanCard.name: discount
PlanCard.description: Figma `badge` — the lg Discount badge in the footer. `true` labels it "Discount".

PlanCard.name: from
PlanCard.description: Figma `price-from` — the "from" line above the price.

PlanCard.name: logos
PlanCard.description: Logos for the logo row; implies `smiles`.

PlanCard.name: moreLogos
PlanCard.description: The +N bubble at the end of the logo row. Default 4 with placeholders.

PlanCard.name: smiles
PlanCard.description: Figma `logo-row` (md, 32px logos). Shows Smiles placeholders unless `logos` is given.

ProductCard.name: colors
ProductCard.description: Figma `badge-or-color=color-spot` — swatches (CSS colours) shown in place of the badge.

ProductCard.name: discount
ProductCard.description: Figma `badge-or-color=badge` — the lg Discount badge label, e.g. "20% off".

ProductCard.name: logos
ProductCard.description: Figma `logo-row` (sm). `true` shows placeholders; package and product only.

ProductCard.name: tint
ProductCard.description: A `.card-bg-color` tint name (Figma 25710:20065) for the panel. A raw CSS colour still works.

ProductCard.name: title
ProductCard.default: iPhone Clear Case For Safe Use

ProductCard.name: type
ProductCard.description: Which card-features sibling this is. `addon` is the V1.1 name of `package`.

DealCard.name: badge
DealCard.description: @deprecated Use `discount` (a label). A node passed here renders in the discount row.

DealCard.name: discount
DealCard.description: Figma `discount` — the md Discount badge label, e.g. "20% off".

DealCard.name: image
DealCard.description: @deprecated V1.1 image card. Rendered in the logo-row slot; Figma's deals card has no image.

DealCard.name: likes
DealCard.description: Like count in the feedback pill, e.g. "120.8k". Setting it (or a handler) shows the pill.

DealCard.name: wasPrice
DealCard.description: Figma `discounted-string` — the struck-through old price, e.g. "AED 500".

NewCard.name: badge
NewCard.description: Figma `badge` — the "New card" badge. Independent of `selected`; on by default.

NewCard.name: selected
NewCard.description: Figma `selected` axis — the gradient ring (the last carousel card, for three days).

ServiceCard.name: badge
ServiceCard.description: A badge node, e.g. `<Badge offer="new-plan" size="md">New plan</Badge>`.

ServiceCard.name: size
ServiceCard.description: Figma `size` axis; omit to let the cell fill its grid track.

Highlight.name: action
Highlight.description: Figma type=action — the glass action bar.

Highlight.name: background
Highlight.description: @deprecated V1.2 has one surface: image + midnight gradient.

Highlight.name: cta
Highlight.description: @deprecated V1.2 has no bare CTA — use `action`. Still renders when no `action` is set.

Highlight.name: image
Highlight.description: Image URL for the banner fill.

Highlight.name: placement
Highlight.description: Figma `placement`. `stacked` lays this banner and `items` out as 307-wide peeking cards.

Highlight.name: tone
Highlight.description: @deprecated V1.2 has one surface: image + midnight gradient (design-questions q2).

Recommendation.name: carousel
Recommendation.description: Figma `carousel` — this card and `items` as 338-wide peeking cards.

Recommendation.name: description
Recommendation.default: Handpicked offers based on how you use etisalat.

Recommendation.name: icon
Recommendation.description: Figma `visual-asset` — a 32px logo. Smiles placeholder by default; `null` hides it.

Recommendation.name: inverse
Recommendation.description: Figma `inverse` — glass on a dark backdrop (default) vs white.

SmilesBalance.name: cta
SmilesBalance.description: @deprecated V1.0 gold strip's Redeem button — absent in V1.2. Renders only when set.

SmilesBalance.name: label
SmilesBalance.description: The unit line under the total.

SmilesBalance.name: nextTier
SmilesBalance.description: The tier the footer line points to.

SmilesBalance.name: tier
SmilesBalance.description: The member's current tier (pill, activated only). `null` hides the pill.

Voucher.name: description
Voucher.description: Second line under the title, e.g. "above AED 60+".

Input.name: clearable
Input.description: Show the 24px dismiss (clear) button while the field is active and has a value.

Input.name: error
Input.description: Error hint below the field (Figma status=error); drives the error stroke.

Input.name: helper
Input.description: Neutral hint below the field (Figma status=neutral).

Input.name: htmlType
Input.description: Underlying HTML input type (password, email, …) for type="text".

Input.name: leadingIcon
Input.description: Leading slot: a 24px icon-size — pass a 20px glyph.

Input.name: statusIcon
Input.description: Show the `info` glyph before the status text (Figma `info-icon`, default true).

Input.name: success
Input.description: Success hint below the field (Figma status=success).

Input.name: trailingIcon
Input.description: Trailing slot: a 24px icon-size — pass a 20px glyph.

Input.name: type
Input.description: Figma `type` axis. dropdown/picker render read-only with a trailing chevron.

Input.name: variant
Input.description: @deprecated V1.0 axis — V1.1 has a single filled style; ignored.

Chip.name: check
Chip.description: Show a check mark as the leading marker while selected (Figma marker `type=check`).

Chip.name: dismissLabel
Chip.description: Accessible name for the dismiss button. Defaults to "Remove <label>".

Chip.name: leadingIcon
Chip.description: Leading marker (Figma `.chips.marker type=custom-icon`): a 16px box — pass a 12px glyph.

Chip.name: loading
Chip.description:
@deprecated V1.2 chips have no loader. Still renders a spinner in the marker slot and
suppresses clicks.

Chip.name: onDismiss
Chip.description:
Makes the chip removable (Figma `.chips-core-status selected=true`): a trailing 20px
dismiss that calls this. The label stays a separate button for `onClick`.

FilterPill.name: inverse
FilterPill.description: Inverse color scheme for dark (midnight/brand) surfaces (Figma `inverse=true`).

Checkbox.name: inverse
Checkbox.description: Inverse color scheme for dark (midnight/brand) surfaces (Figma `color-scheme=inverse`).

Checkbox.name: radio
Checkbox.description:
Render as a radio (single-selection) — a circle instead of a square. Same mark,
colors and states (Figma `radio (single selection)=yes`, node 27685:5017).

ConsentCheckbox.name: inverse
ConsentCheckbox.description: Inverse color scheme for dark (midnight/brand) surfaces (Figma `color-scheme=inverse`).

ConsentCheckbox.name: links
ConsentCheckbox.description: Inline legal links (Figma `link-1`, `link-2`). Two are joined by `conjunction`.

ConsentCheckbox.name: prefix
ConsentCheckbox.description: Text before the first link (Figma `title-string`, "Agree to").

Radio.name: inverse
Radio.description: Inverse color scheme for dark (midnight/brand) surfaces (Figma `color-scheme=inverse`).

Switcher.name: inverse
Switcher.description: Inverse scheme for brand/midnight surfaces: white track, red knob when on.

Switcher.name: size
Switcher.description:
`md` 40×24 (Figma small=false) or `sm` 32×20 (small=true). `lg` is the deprecated
pre-V1.2 name for `md`.

Tabs.name: icons
Tabs.description:
Leading glyph per tab, index-aligned with `tabs`, drawn in a 20px icon-size. A string is
an icon-set name rendered at Figma's 16px; a node renders as given. Figma's rule is that
the icon is always present; code keeps it optional so text-only rows still work.

Tabs.name: inverse
Tabs.description: Inverse (glass) pills for brand, midnight or glass surfaces — e.g. the TopBar tabs add-on.

Tabs.name: scope

PickerOption.name: badge
PickerOption.description:
Status badge along the bottom of the tile (Figma `badges`). A string or number renders the
published neutral sm status badge across the tile; any other node renders as given.
Hidden while disabled.

PickerOption.name: caption
PickerOption.description: Secondary line under the value (body/xs) — e.g. a unit.

StatusRibbon.name: action
StatusRibbon.description: Trailing action label (Figma `show-action`); the tap target spans the label + icon.

StatusRibbon.name: leadingIcon
StatusRibbon.description: Leading glyph, drawn in a 24px box (Figma `show-icon`).

ButtonGroup.name: orientation
ButtonGroup.description:
`vertical` stacks the buttons; `horizontal` puts secondary+primary side by side
(Figma `button-stack` horizontal false|true, 31617:1409).

ButtonGroup.name: tertiary
ButtonGroup.description: Tertiary/link action — always renders on its own centered row.

PaymentRow.name: icon
PaymentRow.description: Payment method tile (logo/image); clipped to a 40x40 rounded square.

PriceLine.name: actionIcon
PriceLine.description: Trailing icon inside the tertiary button (Figma's 20px `.button-icon`).

PriceLine.name: actionLabel
PriceLine.description: Tertiary button under the label (Figma `button type=tertiary size=md`).

PriceLine.name: note
PriceLine.description:
@deprecated Code-only: `price-line` 33496:60459 has no note under the value. Still
renders (body.sm, muted) so existing screens keep working; prefer `actionLabel`.

ActionBlock.name: payment
ActionBlock.description: Payment-method summary (use <PaymentRow/>); renders beside the actions, half each.

ActionBlock.name: ribbon
ActionBlock.description: Status strip across the very top (use <StatusRibbon/>).

ActionBlock.name: terms
ActionBlock.description: Checkbox line — pass a <ConsentCheckbox/> (or a <Checkbox/>) so state stays with the caller.

CtaFooter.name: homeIndicator
CtaFooter.description:
iOS home-indicator block below the actions (Figma `home-indicator`, default true).
It is also the bar's only bottom spacing: with it off the actions sit flush, as in
the symbol.

CtaFooter.name: payment
CtaFooter.description: Payment-method summary (use <PaymentRow/>); renders beside the actions, half each.

CtaFooter.name: ribbon
CtaFooter.description: Status strip across the very top (use <StatusRibbon/>).

CtaFooter.name: rounded
CtaFooter.description: Round the top corners (24px). Figma's `cta-bar` always does; pass `false` for a flush edge.

CtaFooter.name: surface
CtaFooter.description: White card + `shadow/md` (Figma `surface`, default true). `false` = transparent, no shadow.

CtaFooter.name: terms
CtaFooter.description: Checkbox line — pass a <ConsentCheckbox/> (or a <Checkbox/>) so state stays with the caller.

PlanUsageBar.name: total
PlanUsageBar.description: Plan allowance the block is measured against.

PlanUsageBar.name: label
PlanUsageBar.description: Category name, right-aligned in the track — e.g. "Local Data".

PlanUsageBar.name: labelState
PlanUsageBar.description: Ink of the category label. Omit to switch automatically once the fill covers it.

PlanUsageBar.name: note
PlanUsageBar.description: Second line under the value, e.g. "Expires 3 days".

PlanUsageBar.name: remaining
PlanUsageBar.description: Amount left in the plan. This is what the block shows and measures.

PlanUsageBar.name: used
PlanUsageBar.description: @deprecated Pass `remaining`. Kept so `used`-based call sites keep working.

PlanUsageBar.name: valueState
PlanUsageBar.description: Ink of the value and note. Omit to switch automatically once the fill covers them.

Snackbar.name: action
Snackbar.description: Label of the primary / sm / inverse button (Figma `Show button`).

Snackbar.name: aed
Snackbar.description: Figma `aed-text` — an amount after the message, e.g. "AED 60.00".

Snackbar.name: backdrop
Snackbar.description: Figma `back-ground=yes`: a blurred gradient scrim behind the pill, for busy content.

Snackbar.name: onDismiss
Snackbar.description: @deprecated The V1.2 snack bar has no dismiss control.

Snackbar.name: status
Snackbar.description: Figma `.icon-snackbar-status` axis. Takes precedence over `tone`. Default `info`.

Snackbar.name: subtitle
Snackbar.description: @deprecated The V1.2 snack bar has no second line.

Snackbar.name: tone
Snackbar.description: @deprecated Use `status`. `tone="default"` still renders the old bare, centred message.

Alert.name: action
Alert.description: Label of the primary / sm / inverse button. One CTA per alert.

Alert.name: actionPlacement
Alert.description: Default `end`. Use `below` when the body runs to several lines.

Alert.name: stack
Alert.description: Figma `Stack=yes`: how many alerts share this slot (2+ draws the step counter).

Alert.name: stackIndex
Alert.description: Which stacked alert is in view, 0-based.

AlertModal.name: footer
AlertModal.description: The cta-bar content — usually one or two block `Button`s. Padded spacing/xl.

AlertModal.name: onDismiss
AlertModal.description: @deprecated Use `onClose`. Still dismisses on a scrim click in the centred dialog.

AlertModal.name: visual
AlertModal.description: The `status-banner` hero (illustration). Framed with a 4px inset.

Section.name: carousel
Section.description: Body scrolls horizontally and bleeds to the edges (carousels).

Section.name: filterPill
Section.description: Optional filter pill, inline after the title (Figma `filter-pill`). Pass `inverse` on dark surfaces.

Section.name: gradient
Section.description: Sunset glow over the body (Figma `.section-body` `gradient`). Only on the most important section.

Section.name: size
Section.description: Body slot size — reserves the row height for the card type it holds.

Section.name: titleLine
Section.description: Clamp the title to one or two lines (Figma `lines`).

Section.name: trigger
Section.description: Header trigger: the section-link chevron, a tertiary lg button, or none (Figma `.section-trigger` link | button).

Card.name: surface
Card.description: `default` = white, `inverse` = midnight-raised (NOT the GeneralCard / Figma naming).

Card.name: width
Card.description: fixed width for use inside a carousel

GeneralCard.name: badge
GeneralCard.description: A `Badge` (offer or status), placed 12px in from the corner.

GeneralCard.name: badgePlacement
GeneralCard.description: Badge alignment (Figma `.badge-placement` Left | Center | Right, mirrored in RTL).

GeneralCard.name: carousel
GeneralCard.description: Carousel cell (147 wide) instead of a grid cell that fills its slot.

GeneralCard.name: image
GeneralCard.description: Image URL, or your own node (it is sized to the media box).

GeneralCard.name: size
GeneralCard.description: Media size (Figma `size`): sm 64 · md 128 · lg 224 full-bleed.

GeneralCard.name: surface
GeneralCard.description: Figma `surface`: `default` is the DARK card, `inverse` the white one (as published).

GeneralCard.name: topAlignment
GeneralCard.description: Figma `top-alignment`: true = image and badge at the top, title at the bottom.

FAQ.name: categories
FAQ.description: Category chip labels. Omit for no chip row.

FAQ.name: defaultOpen
FAQ.description: Index into `items` of the item open at first. Default: none.

StatusIcon.name: icon
StatusIcon.description: An icon-set name to replace the default glyph for this type.

PageTitle.name: status
PageTitle.description: Outcome the status icon reflects (lg and md only).

PageTitle.name: statusIcon
PageTitle.description: Replaces the status icon's default glyph.

PageHeader.name: title
PageHeader.description: Up to two lines; each pairs a muted word with a strong word.

PageHeader.name: icon
PageHeader.description: 56px icon slot — typically a 3D illustration. Do not resize.

TopBar.name: account
TopBar.description: Left column: account — optional avatar, greeting over a masked number with a chevron.

TopBar.name: actionBar
TopBar.description: @deprecated V1.0 sub-card — pass a card via `children` instead.

TopBar.name: actions
TopBar.description: Right column: 40px round controls (Figma `topbar-link`). Pass icons.

TopBar.name: bigTitle
TopBar.description: Title block: the large title (heading/lg text style, 24px).

TopBar.name: chevron
TopBar.description: Chevron after the big title (24px, default off) and the account number (16px, default on).

TopBar.name: children
TopBar.description: Add-ons: search, tabs, chips, stepper, action cards… each gets 16px top padding.

TopBar.name: compact
TopBar.description:
@deprecated Code-only 56px single-row header with no status bar. Figma has no
compact top bar — every V1.2 surface carries the status bar and header row.

TopBar.name: eyebrow
TopBar.description: Title block (`.topbar-title`): overline above the large title, body/md.

TopBar.name: eyebrowChevron
TopBar.description: Title block: 16px chevron after the overline (Figma `overline-chevron`).

TopBar.name: greeting
TopBar.description: @deprecated Use `account={{ greeting }}`. Renders the account display.

TopBar.name: leading
TopBar.description: Left column: custom content (e.g. an avatar). For a back button use `onBack`.

TopBar.name: logo
TopBar.description: Middle: the etisalat logo (`true`) or a custom node.

TopBar.name: onBack
TopBar.description: Left column: renders the 40px back button (Figma `.topbar-body-left-side type=back-button`).

TopBar.name: rounded
TopBar.description: Figma rounds every surface (36 top / 20 bottom). `false` squares the corners.

TopBar.name: statusBar
TopBar.description: Faux iOS status bar (on by default on every surface).

TopBar.name: subtext
TopBar.description: Title block: supporting line under the title, body/lg.

TopBar.name: subtitle
TopBar.description: Middle: body/md line under the page name (Figma `description-string`).

TopBar.name: surface
TopBar.description:
Figma `surface`: `brand` (brand-red), `midnight`, `white` or `none` (Figma `false`,
transparent — for a midnight or light-grey canvas). Defaults to `brand` when an
`account` or `bigTitle` is given, else `white`. `default` is a deprecated alias of `white`.

TopBar.name: title
TopBar.description: Middle: page name, centred title/sm (Figma `.topbar-page-name`). Ignored when `logo` is set.

TopBar.name: trailing
TopBar.description: Right column: a link or button after the controls.

TopBar.name: variant
TopBar.description: @deprecated Use `surface`.

ListRow.name: action
ListRow.description: Under the subtitle — a tertiary md `Button` (Figma `.content button`).

ListRow.name: badge
ListRow.description: Trailing badge under the value (Figma `badges-offers` md).

ListRow.name: icon
ListRow.description: Leading glyph, shown in the 40px icon tile (Figma `.logo type=icon`).

ListRow.name: inverse
ListRow.description: Figma `.list-item-scheme inverse` — white ink for dark or glass surroundings.

ListRow.name: logo
ListRow.description: Leading brand logo / art, 40px on surface/base/default (Figma `.logo type=logo`).

ListRow.name: onTooltipClick
ListRow.description: Makes the tooltip glyph a button. Ignored when the row itself has `onClick`.

ListRow.name: padding
ListRow.description: Figma `.list-item-padding`. Defaults to `true` for info, `false` for price.

ListRow.name: surface
ListRow.description:
Card surface (padded rows only). Light: default·subtle·sunken·glass. Inverse:
glass·midnight-base·midnight-raised·midnight-transparent·white-transparent.
Defaults to `default`, or `glass` when `inverse`.

ListRow.name: type
ListRow.description: Figma `type`. `info` (default) = padded card on a surface; `price` = flat line item.

NavBar.name: scrollDirection
NavBar.description:
Figma `.navbar-scroll` axis. `down` collapses to icons only (scrolled down);
`up` (default) shows icon + label. Transitions are animated.

ActionBar.name: action
ActionBar.description: Trailing action — typically a `<Button>`. Only one trailing trigger; do not combine with `chevron` or `switcher`.

ActionBar.name: chevron
ActionBar.description: Show a trailing chevron instead of a button — the whole bar becomes the tap target.

ActionBar.name: colorScheme
ActionBar.description:
Figma `color-scheme`: the ink. Defaults from `surface` — `inverse` for the dark/glass
surfaces, else `default`. Set `default` with `surface="glass"` for the light-family glass.

ActionBar.name: icon
ActionBar.description: Leading visual (icon or image) shown in a 40×40 tile. Omit for text at the leading edge.

ActionBar.name: stack
ActionBar.description: Multiple-stack — layered "stacked cards" look. Inverse scheme only (Figma `type=multiple`).

ActionBar.name: subtitle
ActionBar.description: Secondary line — `body.md`, truncates with ellipsis (Figma limit ~21 chars).

ActionBar.name: surface
ActionBar.description:
Backing surface. Light family: `default`·`subtle`·`sunken`·`glass`; inverse family:
`glass`·`white-transparent`·`midnight-base`·`midnight-raised`·`midnight-transparent`.

Tooltip.name: action
Tooltip.description: Rich only — the action block's button.

Tooltip.name: onClose
Tooltip.description: Rich only — shows the `.tooltip-icon-button` close at the top end.

BottomSheet.name: closeButton
BottomSheet.description: Figma `close-button`. Default: shown whenever `onDismiss` is set.

BottomSheet.name: display
BottomSheet.description: @deprecated V1.2 has no Display axis; the sheet is always light.

BottomSheet.name: grabber
BottomSheet.description: Figma `grabber` boolean. Default: on, except for `system-message`.

BottomSheet.name: icon
BottomSheet.description: Figma `icon` — a 40px logo tile above the title (pass an image or an icon).

BottomSheet.name: pills
BottomSheet.description: Figma `pills` — a row of `Chip`s under the title.

BottomSheet.name: subheader
BottomSheet.description: @deprecated V1.1 Subheader. Use `pills`; still rendered under the title.

BottomSheet.name: type
BottomSheet.description: Figma `type`. `system-message` drops the grabber by default. Default `detailed`.

BottomSheet.name: visual
BottomSheet.description: Figma `visual-asset` — media above the header, framed with a 4px inset and r16.

IconBox.name: category
IconBox.description: Figma `category`: `2d` insets the glyph; `logo` clips artwork to the full box.

IconBox.name: icon
IconBox.description: Icon-set glyph to draw at the Figma size for this box. Ignored when children are given.

Badge.name: chevron
Badge.description:
Figma `.badges-core` `chevron`: a trailing chevron after the label. Every published
badge ships with it off.

ProgressBar.name: tone
ProgressBar.description: Optional fill override; omit for the Figma V1.1 default (text.positive.subtle green).

Stepper.name: inverse
Stepper.description: Inverse color scheme for dark (midnight/brand) surfaces.

MoreItems.name: size
MoreItems.description: Circle diameter in px or any CSS length; default icon/xl (24).

LogoRow.name: glass
LogoRow.description: Figma `style=glass`: each logo sits on a glass tile.

LogoRow.name: logos
LogoRow.description: Logo artwork: elements sized to fill their circle, or image URLs.

LogoRow.name: moreSurface
LogoRow.description: The `more-items` surface; every Figma logo-row uses `inverse`.

LogoRow.name: size
LogoRow.description: Figma `size`. Defaults to md (32px), the size this component rendered before V1.2.

AtomSurface.name: level
AtomSurface.description:
@deprecated V1.0 elevation axis with no Figma counterpart; use `surfaceColor`.
Retained so existing call sites keep their current fill.

AtomSurface.name: surfaceColor
AtomSurface.description: Figma `surface-color` axis — the seven shared-atom values plus `brand`.

CardBgColor.name: fixedSize
CardBgColor.description: Render at the Figma swatch footprint (card/width/lg x card/height/lg).

SectionLinkButton.name: surface
SectionLinkButton.description:
@deprecated V1.1 axis. `default` = solid default; `inverse` = glass + inverse (what it
rendered). Use `glass` / `inverse`.

Logo.name: color
Logo.description: Overrides the version's ink. Pass `currentColor` to inherit from CSS instead.

Logo.name: rtl
Logo.description: Arabic lockup / wordmark. Logomark and bilingual are direction-free.

Logo.name: size
Logo.description: Rendered size in px; the symbol is a square.

Logo.name: type
Logo.description: A `.etisalat-logo-variations` artwork. Omit for the `etisalat-logo` symbol.

Logo.name: version
Logo.description: Figma color-scheme. `midnight` is deprecated (removed in V1.2).

Button.name: block
Button.description: Stretch to fill the container width (block CTA).

Button.name: leadingIcon
Button.description:
Leading icon. The slot is 24 / 20 / 16 (lg / md / sm) with 2px inset, so pass an
`<Icon size>` of 20 / 16 / 12.

Button.name: loading
Button.description:
Show a spinner in the leading-icon slot and suppress clicks (Figma `.button-icon loader=true`).
Keeps the default palette — loading is not the disabled state.

Button.name: scheme
Button.description:
Colour scheme (Figma V1.2 `scheme`). Takes precedence over `surface` and `tone`.
Secondary follows the published symbol, whose bindings are crossed relative to the
other types: `scheme="inverse"` is the dark (midnight) outline and `scheme="midnight"`
is the white outline. Logged as a design question.

Button.name: surface
Button.description: @deprecated Use `scheme`. Kept as a back-compat alias; `scheme` wins when both are set.

Button.name: tone
Button.description: @deprecated Use `scheme`. Kept as a back-compat alias.

Button.name: trailingIcon
Button.description: Trailing icon — same slot sizes as `leadingIcon`.

UaePassButton.name: block
UaePassButton.description: Stretch to fill the container width.

UaePassButton.name: children
UaePassButton.description: Label override. Defaults to the Figma copy for `variant`.

UaePassButton.name: variant
UaePassButton.description:
Figma `type`: `login` "Login with UAE PASS" · `continue` "Continue with UAE PASS" ·
`rtl` the Arabic login label, laid out right-to-left (logo after the text).
